findings.message: Round 1's F1 fix (commit 6ce579d6, wiring RETIRED_LESSONS into migrateLessonIdentity in Storage.ts) is correct by inspection — retiredPositionByLegacy correctly falls back through idToPosition for legacy numbers 15-25, and the fixer's own transcript confirms manual verification (legacy 15 → lesson-12's position, legacy 19 → lesson-tone-marks/lesson-14 resolve without throwing). But no automated test exercises this path: every existing describe block in Storage.test.ts (migrateLessonIdentity, migrateState, importData) calls migrateLessonIdentity against a synthetic RESEQUENCED fixture, never against the real default `lessonSequence` with an actual retired legacy number (15-25) from RETIRED_LESSONS. The fixer's own verification test was temporary and not committed. If a future edit to RETIRED_LESSONS or to the resolve() fallback regresses this path, nothing in the suite would catch it — exactly the silent-migration-failure hazard CONTEXT.md's Rule 1 was written to prevent.
findings.why_not_fixed: Storage.ts and Storage.test.ts belong to phase 1's covers, not phase 4's, and concurrent tasks may be editing files outside this phase's scope right now; per this round's cross-phase restriction I report rather than repair. The owning phase is re-reviewed regardless.
findings.effort_basis: add one test to Storage.test.ts that calls migrateLessonIdentity (or migrateState) with the default production lessonSequence and a state carrying a legacy number from RETIRED_LESSONS (e.g. completedLessons: [19], or a card with lessonNumber: 17), asserting it resolves to the absorbing lesson's position without throwing — bounded, no fixture changes needed beyond importing RETIRED_LESSONS
